title: Freshworks acquires AI startup Robusta to strengthen IT operations platform
summary: Freshworks acquires AI startup Robusta to strengthen IT operations platform
detailed: The acquisition will bring Robusta’s AI-based incident investigation technology to Freshservice, Freshworks’ IT service management platform. Financial details of the deal were not disclosed.
